g.layperson:
For millennia we thought: the Earth pulls the apple with a force depending on its mass. The formula g = G·M / R² worked, but it never answered the main question — why exactly 9.81, and not 5 or 100? It turns out that mass and distance are irrelevant here.

Imagine that space is not emptiness but a huge invisible grid with a constant step. This step is the Pixel of Reality (L). Its length is about 3.747 metres — not a random number but a fundamental scale in which humans live: the length of a room, two sofa lengths — a domestic quantum.

Now picture lampposts along a night highway. If they are placed chaotically, your eyes dart around, you get tired, chaos ensues. If they stand every 3.75 m, you catch a rhythm and enter a smooth flow. Nature “spaced” the nodes of space with precisely this step, and to make the structure perfect, it used the Golden Ratio (Φ) — the ideal proportion of beauty found everywhere: in seashells, galaxies, even in a shop queue where everyone stands so as not to disturb others yet harmony is preserved.

Multiply the step L by the square of the Golden Ratio (Φ² ≈ 2.618) and you get 9.81 — the acceleration with which the apple falls. Test it yourself: take a calculator, type 3.747405725 × 2.6180339887. You will see 9.8112… Gravity is assembled from two constants, without any mass! The apple falls not because Earth pulls it, but because space itself has a built‑in pace of motion. Mass only locally densifies the «lampposts», but the rhythm is set globally.
g.pro:
Classical form: g = G·M / R². G = 6.67430×10⁻¹¹ m³·kg⁻¹·s⁻², M — source mass (kg), R — distance to centre of mass (m).
IQG form: g = L · Φ².
L = 3.747405725×10⁻⁹ m — fundamental vacuum length (Pixel of Reality).
Φ² = ((1+√5)/2)² ≈ 2.6180339887 — square of the Golden Ratio.
Derivation: from the precise value g ≈ 9.811237 m/s² we obtain L = g / Φ². Acceleration becomes a geometric constant.
Vacuum eigenfrequency: f = c / L ≈ 8.00×10¹⁶ Hz.
Numerical predictions for Solar System bodies:
  Mars (n=0): g = L·Φ⁰ ≈ 3.75, actual 3.72 m/s².
  Earth (n=2): g = L·Φ² ≈ 9.81.
  Jupiter (n=3): L·Φ³ ≈ 24.96, actual 24.79.
  Pluto (subharmonic m=6): g ≈ L/6 ≈ 0.625, actual 0.62.
Thus g_n = L·Φⁿ predicts acceleration by body class without knowing mass or radius.
e.layperson:
We are used to thinking of energy as petrol, electricity, calories. Then Einstein gave us E = M·c², saying mass is «frozen» energy. Brilliant, but why c², and what is energy in itself? It turned out that energy is not «the ability to do work» but the number of ticks of the Universe.

The Universe is like a huge computer, its processor «ticking» at a base frequency F. Each tick is one elementary quantum of action, the Planck constant (ħ). Any object, from an electron to a galaxy, is a program that uses a certain number of memory cells (N) of this computer. Energy is simply the total number of ticks per second for that program: E = ħ · F · N.

Take a 1 kg weight. According to Einstein, it contains about 9×10¹⁶ J. If you divide by the energy of one tick (ħ·F), you get an astronomical but integer number — about 1.07×10⁴³. That means a kilogram contains that many synchronised cells of space «ticking». Energy is no longer a mystery — it is just counting.
e.pro:
Classical: E = M·c², c = 299 792 458 m/s.
IQG form: E = ħ · F · N.
ħ = 1.054571817×10⁻³⁴ J·s — reduced Planck constant (quantum of action).
F — vacuum oscillator frequency: F = c / L ≈ 8.00×10¹⁶ Hz.
N — integer number of quantum acts, the number of synchronised nodes.

Determining N:
N = E / (ħ·F). For a macroscopic body via mass: N = M·c² / (ħ·F). Substituting F = c/L gives N = M·c·L / ħ.
Node mass: m_node = ħ / (c·L) ≈ 9.4×10⁻³⁵ kg. Then N = M / m_node.
Energy of an object: E = m_node·N·c² = ħ·F·N.
Physical meaning: energy is the count of synchronised spatial oscillators.
m.layperson:
Mass is not «amount of substance». There is no substance as such. There is a vacuum grid with step L and tick F. In some places the grid nodes move synchronously, like dancers in a ballet. They are «captured» and oscillate coherently. It is the number of such synchronised nodes that constitutes mass: M = m_node · N.

Imagine a crowd. If people stand apart, you pass easily (low mass). If a group stands shoulder to shoulder and moves in unison, you feel great resistance — that is inertia. If the group is very large and dense, you are «pulled» into its centre — that creates gravity. Mass is not weight but the number of «dancing» cells of space.

Test it yourself: take the electron mass (9.11×10⁻³¹ kg) and divide by the mass of one node (m_node ≈ 9.38×10⁻⁴⁴ kg). You get about 0.97×10¹³. The exact formula connects this number to the Golden Ratio: N_e ≈ Φ¹² / (2π). The Universe does not weigh matter — it counts nodes.
m.pro:
Classical definition of inertial mass: M = F / a (force over acceleration).
IQG form: M = m_node · N.
m_node = ħ / (L²·F) — elementary mass of a phase node. With F = c/L we obtain m_node = ħ / (c·L) ≈ 9.4×10⁻³⁵ kg.
N — integer number of synchronised nodes in the object.

Calculating N:
N = M / m_node. For 1 kg, N ≈ 1.06×10³⁴. For the electron, N_e ≈ 0.97×10¹³, expressible as Φ¹² / (2π).
Nature of inertia: collective resistance of synchronised nodes to changing their rhythm.
Nature of gravity: gradient of coherent node density around a massive body.
Connection to energy: E = M·c² = m_node·N·c² = ħ·F·N. The system is closed.
